content: Hi how can i assist you today
My electric kettle clicks exactly when I think of a person. It’s like it responds to the thought.
Kettles click at thermostat thresholds and during heat cycling. Did those clicks occur near boil completion or reheat cycles?
Often right as it reaches a boil, sometimes a minute later.
That aligns with thermostat contacts toggling. If you watch the indicator light while timing clicks, you may see a pattern tied to the heating cycle rather than the thought.
I can time the clicks next boil.
A simple timeline—start, boil, cool, reheat—beside click marks usually shows the mechanism at work.
If clicks align to those phases, that explains it.
Exactly; the cycle would account for the timing.
